name: VibeAR
summary:
**Your terminal, your editor and your agents — in the room with you.**

VibeAR turns your Quest into a mixed-reality cockpit for your computer. Windows float in passthrough around your real desk: as many terminals as you need, browsers, notes, code and PDF viewers, 3D models, and a live mirror of your Mac screen. Move them with a pinch, keep your keyboard visible, and get back to work.

**Built for coding with AI agents**
